neighbours.label: the word right before 'pay'/'paycheck'/'wages' in an employment-pay context (predicts pay)
fire: Premiums are deducted every month from his or her paycheck at work.
She accepted a 30 percent pay cut to keep her job at the plant.
The money was withheld from their pay by the factory owner.
Low-wage workers have endured stagnant wages for over a decade.
The law guarantees women equal pay for equal work.
How much tax is taken out of my paycheck each month?
The union demanded that nurses receive overtime pay for weekends.
Teachers in the district have not had a pay raise in years.
quiet: Premiums are explained every month in a letter from the insurer.
She accepted a new role to keep her job at the plant.
The money was donated to the library by the factory owner.
Low-wage workers have endured long commutes for over a decade.
The law guarantees women equal access to public buildings.
How much flour is used in the bakery each month?
The union demanded that nurses receive better chairs for weekends.
Teachers in the district have not had a new building in years.

notes: - pole's output promotes ' pay', ' pays', ' raises'
